title: critonia quadrangularis
intro: Critonia quadrangularis, commonly known as "Quadrangular Acmadenia" or "Praia do Norte," is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating fever, inflammation, and pain, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The health benefits of Critonia quadrangularis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
